name: aurora-chat-block
title: Aurora Interactive Chat
author: jmagar <https://github.com/jmagar>
description: Fully interactive mock chat combining Aurora MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Chat Attachment, and Marker primitives with streaming, reactions, retry, copy, attachment preview, and composer interactions.
docs:
Aurora interactive chat showcase composed entirely from the new Aurora conversation primitives. The demo is local-only and includes fake streaming, pinned-end scrolling, jump controls, mock attachment lifecycle, preview, reactions, copy, retry, and reset behavior.

Registry dependencies: aurora-tokens, aurora-components, aurora-button, aurora-spinner, aurora-textarea, aurora-message-scroller, aurora-message, aurora-bubble, aurora-chat-attachment, aurora-marker.
